climbing_route.label: Southeast flank from the Himmel-Otto col
climbing_route.notes: From the col the Southeast Route continues up easier ground on Himmelhorn's southeast flank to the 7,880 ft summit.

wa_hozomeen_mountain_south_peak_southwes.skip_reason: The approach text stops at a saddle reported at roughly 6,800 ft 'below the final pitches' and says nothing about the pitches themselves - no climbing description to re-home.

climbing_route.label: East Ridge/East Face to the summit block
climbing_route.notes: The technical climbing starts at a rocky buttress at about 6,100 ft; this is the start of the East Ridge/East Face line most parties use to reach the summit block. Rock is generally loose once off-trail.

climbing_route.label: West-side gullies back to the crest
climbing_route.notes: From the col, do not continue straight up the ridge crest - instead drop about 50 ft onto the west side of the ridge and climb one of several gullies (~100 ft) back up to the crest.

climbing_route.label: Ridge crest to the South Peak summit
climbing_route.notes: Follow the ridge over a mix of snow and blocky rock, with some exposure, to the South Peak summit.

wa_inspiration_peak_west_ridge.skip_reason: The approach text runs only to the base of the climb - camp, the crossing to the Terror Glacier and the crevassed glacier travel below Inspiration's south side - and describes none of the West Ridge climbing above.

climbing_route.label: Gully/ledge system splitting the south face
climbing_route.notes: From the saddle follow the boot path north, just below/along the crest, for a few hundred yards to the base of an obvious gully/ledge system splitting Kaleetan's south face - the standard finish, roughly 400-600 vertical feet of scrambling on loose, exfoliating rock. The summit gully and upper shoulder hold snow well into early summer, with recent trip reports describing an ice axe and light crampons needed on the northwest-facing finish into June/July; the rock on the upper peak is loose throughout and exposure increases near the top.

climbing_route.label: Short summit ridge
climbing_route.notes: The gully exits onto a short summit ridge with one more brief scramble to the true summit (6,259-6,260 ft).

wa_klawatti_peak_southeast_face.skip_reason: The approach text ends where it reaches the base of the technical route - a short direct climb up the south-facing flank from Klawatti Col - and only names the bergschrund and short rock step as the base; it describes none of the climbing above.

wa_klawatti_peak_sw_buttress.skip_reason: The approach text is a different peak's: it describes climbing toward Eldorado's famous narrow snow ridge and the 8,868-foot summit, and its own closing note says this route is NOT on Eldorado Peak itself. Nothing in it describes the Klawatti SW Buttress climbing.
